Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

spigot 0.2.1

  • The API’s origin check now follows the browser’s Sec-Fetch-Site header when it is sent: same-origin and none pass, anything else gets 403. Behind a proxy that rewrites Host without setting X-Forwarded-Host (nginx in front of Shiny Server, for example), every same-origin request carrying a Referer used to get 403. Requests without Sec-Fetch-Site are checked against Host as before.

spigot 0.2.0

  • Blueprints: spigot_blueprint() groups a section’s pages, API, templates, partials and static files, and spigot_app(blueprints = list("/cars" = cars)) serves its pages under /cars, its API under /api/cars and its static files at /cars/static, which its pages see as {{static}}. vignette("blueprints") explains them and vignette("flask-flow") shows the folder layout.
  • spigot_app(templates =) is a search path for template files, and spigot_app(partials =) gives every page shared partials: a folder (one partial per file) or a named list. A page’s own partials win.
  • spigot_app(static =) serves folders at /static (or /<name> each) in every launch mode, not only when the app folder is run, as www/ is.
  • spigot_app(root =) is the folder that these paths, and the api file, are relative to. It defaults to the working directory, as in 0.1.x.
  • Template files are now read, and their checks run, when spigot_app() builds the app rather than when spigot_page() is called. The errors are the same, and a missing file’s error now lists every place spigot looked. Only the partials a page uses are checked.
  • The site example is now laid out with templates/, static/ and two blueprints. The live example no longer shows a stale tab count when its first reply arrives late.
  • No breaking changes: every new argument defaults to 0.1.1 behaviour.

spigot 0.1.1

  • Internal simplification; no change to behaviour, except that /reactlog now gets the app’s own 404 instead of Shiny’s reactlog. spigot.js now uses current JavaScript syntax (ES2017) and needs fetch, AbortController and ReadableStream, which every current browser has. A {{> name}} partial missing from partials is caught when the page is created.

spigot 0.1.0

  • First release. spigot_app() mounts a plumber router inside a Shiny app, so hand-written pages (spigot_page()) call R endpoints on the same origin and port through spigot.js.
  • API requests are bound to the calling tab’s Shiny session (spigot_session()). By default only open pages of the app can call the API, and cross-origin requests are refused.
  • spigot_emit() and spigot_broadcast() push events to pages; spigot_trigger() sets a Shiny input from an endpoint.
  • Three examples: run_example("minimal"), "live" and "site".
